full_judgment: 6. The learned Advocate next referring to the supplementary affidavit dated 06.02.2017 submits that the complainant-opposite party No. 2, by its Managing Director, filed a Civil Suit being Title Suit No. 24 of 2014 before the Court of learned District Judge, Dhaka against 7(seven) defendants for permanent injunction, compensation and confiscation for pirated products under the Trade Marks Act, 2009 and the copyright Act, 2000 and prayed for a decree for compensation of Tk. 4,32,79,947/- along with other prayers and as such, the impugned criminal proceeding amounts to an abuse of process of the Court and is therefore, liable to be quashed.
